summary: BGM Group Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting the resignation of director Yuehua Ren, Co-CEO Yuqing Li, independent director Lin Zhang, and audit committee chairman Maofan Tang, effective May 7, 2026, each for personal reasons without dispute. The board concurrently appointed Huandi Zhao as Co-CEO and director, Jianping Mao and Junjie Wang as independent directors, with three-year terms. This constitutes a forced/abrupt departure of multiple senior leaders, including the Co-CEO and several board members, making it a special-situation management change. No deal terms apply. Watch for further governance instability or strategic shifts.
